{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below current prices, showing significant lag behind price movements",
    "Forecast bias moves from under-forecasting to over-forecasting as horizons extend, then mean-reverts toward center",
    "Sentiment strength directly correlates with forecast magnitude - stronger sentiment yields larger forecast deviations from historical trends",
    "Model overshoots price reversals when sentiment is strong, especially at shorter horizons",
    "The 7-10 day forecast horizon has the highest correlation with true outcomes, representing an optimal balance between lag and prediction range",
    "When sentiment flips from positive to negative, model forecasts lag by approximately 2-3 forecast steps",
    "Model tends to under-predict price bottoms by 0.5-1.0 EUR and over-predict peaks by a similar margin"
] }
